review_setup_py: review the setup.py to understand the yaml_support package dependencies and metadata
summarize_setup_py: summarize the yaml_support package setup configuration including labgraph numpy PyYAML and other dependencies
refactor_setup_py: refactor the setup.py to update dependency versions or add new install_requires entries
